lesson.topic: How to create sentences in English

yt.capaTitulo: #12 - HOW TO CREATE SENTENCES IN ENGLISH | ADVANCED [Advanced Creativity Game]
material: Youtubers VIDEO FILE #12 "How to create sentences in English - em português" - Dropbox
objetivos: Developing fluency by using common words and expressions in English.
yt.intro: Today, we'll watch a video from Youtube Channel @EnglishinBrazil, from Carina Fragozo. We'll take a look at her advice on creating sentences in English. [Attention: the video is in Portuguese]

video.nome: How to create sentences in English (Carina Fragozo, em português)

pratica.instrucao: Split the class in two groups. Each group takes turns trying to finish the sentences on the next slides. The longer/more complex the sentences, the better.
itens: Now that I've come to think about it, I truly believe that... because...
My opinion has changed from... to...
One of the challenges in my life is...
My favorite activity is... ( v + ing ) 'cause...
I need a favor: would you...?
